resources.string: ORION
Connect to your ORION — at home or away
PC address
e.g. orion-pc.tailXXXX.ts.net
Your Tailscale name works everywhere (home and mobile data); a LAN IP works on your home Wi-Fi only. Pasting a full address such as https://192.168.1.182:8765 is fine.
Port
Use HTTPS (required for talking to ORION by voice)
Enable ORION_REMOTE_TLS=1 on the PC for voice input. If ORION isn\'t serving HTTPS, switch this off or the connection will fail.
Connect

1. On the PC, ask ORION to \"turn on phone access\" (or start him with ORION_REMOTE_ACCESS=1).\n2. Install Tailscale (free) on the PC and this phone and sign in to both, then enter the PC\'s Tailscale name above: ORION is then reachable from anywhere, encrypted, with no port-forwarding.\n3. Pair once with the code ORION shows in his Security Centre. After that the app finds him by itself, on your home Wi-Fi or over Tailscale.
Enter the PC address ORION shows in his log
That isn\'t an address — try something like 192.168.1.182
Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
Change server
Connecting to ORION…
Couldn\'t reach ORION.\nCheck he\'s running with phone access on, and that this phone is on his Wi-Fi or on Tailscale.
Nothing answered at:\n%1$s
ORION answered, but not over HTTPS. Switch off \"Use HTTPS\" under Change server, or start ORION with ORION_REMOTE_TLS=1.
ORION may be serving HTTPS. Switch on \"Use HTTPS\" under Change server.
Retry
Pair this phone
Enter the one-time pairing code shown on the ORION desktop.
ABCD-1234
Pair
Microphone is off for ORION. Allow it in Settings › Apps › ORION › Permissions to talk to him.
